title: Linux & Open Source Bootcamp Scheduled for September 3
author: FOSS Club KIET Committee
venueOrDetails: Date: September 3, 2026 • Venue: Room H808 & Seminar Hall
content: FOSS Club KIET is proud to announce our upcoming Linux & Open Source Bootcamp on September 3, 2026. The bootcamp is tailored to take students from complete Linux beginners to confident command-line users and upstream open-source contributors.
Topics will include dual-boot partitioning, shell scripting with bash, Git version control, GPG commit signing, and submitting clean pull requests to active repositories.
